whatIsSewaloAns: Sewalo is a platform that connects customers with verified local service providers for various services including home repairs, cleaning, beauty, and tutoring.
howToBook: How do I book a service?
howToBookAns: Simply browse through the available services, select the one you need, choose a provider, and confirm your booking.
howToBecomeProvider: How do I become a service provider?
howToBecomeProviderAns: Sign up as a provider, complete your profile with your skills and experience, and create your service listings to start receiving bookings.
howPaymentsWorkAns: Payments are processed securely through our platform. Providers receive payment once the customer confirms the job is completed.
howToCancel: How do I cancel a booking?
howToCancelAns: You can cancel a booking through your bookings page. Please communicate with your provider about any cancellations.
contactSupportFaqAns: You can reach our support team through the Contact Support page, or email us at support@sewalo.com.

howVerifyProvidersAns: Sewalo verifies providers through identity checks, credential verification, and customer reviews to ensure quality and trust.
whatPaymentMethodsAns: We accept various payment methods including mobile banking, digital wallets, and cash on delivery.

whatIfDamageAns: Sewalo has a protection policy for verified bookings. Please report any damages to our support team immediately.
